searchText: Hey guys, a stupid question, Can there be a chain of stable coins backed in a row and at the end backed by the least volatile cryptocurrency? the chain of stable coins might be able to absorb the shocks of the volatility by the cryptocurrency at the end, and ultimately provide us a stable and decentralised currency.
